Name: friendlyGhost's critter swap
Author: tesarahkt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If Pelican Town, why no Pelicans? Seagulls have been retextured to be Pelicans. Some other critters retextured/coloured as well: butterflies, birds, rodents. Part of a longer term project, Rocky Mountain Recolour. All art is by me. This is my first published mod.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download and save to Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Seagulls > Pelicans. Butterflies > species local to the Rocky Mountains. Birds> Stellars Jay and Cardinal. Bunny> Brown. Squirrel> shorter ears and longer snout.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI and Content Patcher[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]
